turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre, yeh toh dil ke bilkul beech ki baat hai — pandrah saal ka sapna aur roza, dono ek saath. Pehle toh yeh samajh lo ki darr lagna bilkul valid hai, tum kuch galat feel nahi kar rahi.

Par honestly? Yeh dono cheezein ek doosre ke against nahi hain. Kuch practical baatein socho:

- Sangeet functions waise bhi shaam/raat ke hote hain — iftar ke baad. Toh dance perform karne tak tum roza khol chuki hogi, khaana-paani ho chuka hoga. Energy wapas aa jaati hai, seriously.
- Asli challenge rehearsals ka hoga, din mein. Wahan tum Shreya se bol sakti ho ki rehearsals iftar ke baad rakho, ya tumhare steps pehle Ramzan se pehle hi tight kar lo. Woh tumhari best friend hai — woh samjhegi, balki adjust karke khush hogi.
- Cocktail night pe drinks skip karna toh tumhare liye waise bhi normal hoga, uska stress mat lo.

Ek baat aur — kya tumne Shreya se yeh darr openly share kiya hai? Ya bas "haan haan karungi" bol rahi ho andar se ghabrate hue? Fifteen saal ki dosti hai, usse bolo: "Main 200% karna chahti hoon, bas Ramzan ke logistics saath mein plan karte hain." Co-director ho tum — schedule pe tumhara bhi haq hai. 💛

Darr kis cheez ka zyada hai — thak jaane ka, ya kisi ko judge karne ka?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Uff. Yeh line — "dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha" — bilkul sahi pakdi tumne. Yahi toh sabse mushkil hota hai na, jab koi villain hi nahi hai story mein. Sirf do log jo tumse alag-alag cheez chahte hain, dono apne pyaar mein.

Ek cheez notice karo: Shreya aur Ammi, dono tumhare liye decide kar rahe hain. Shreya keh rahi hai "roza chhod de," Ammi keh rahi hai "sangeet chhod de." Par tumhari apni position kya hai? Tumne pehle message mein khud bola tha — "main karna bhi chahti hoon" aur roza bhi tumhare liye matter karta hai. Toh shayad tumhara jawab hai: **dono. Na roza chhodna, na Shreya ka sangeet.**

Aur woh possible hai. Yeh koi compromise nahi, yeh tumhari poori identity hai — tum woh ladki ho jo roza bhi rakhti hai aur apni behen jaisi dost ke liye naachti bhi hai. Iftar ke baad.

Shreya ko pyaar se educate karna padega: "Roza chhodna mere liye 'ek din ka farak' nahi hai, yeh meri Allah se baat hai. Par tension mat le — main roza rakh ke bhi teri opening dance karungi, bas rehearsals iftar ke baad rakh." Woh samajh jaayegi, promise.

Ammi ke saath thoda alag conversation hai — unka concern shayad yeh hai ki Ramzan ki ruh mein celebration fit nahi hota. Unse pucho na ki exactly kya cheez unko theek nahi lagti? Kyunki khushi ke mauke mein shareek hona, dost ka haq ada karna — yeh toh galat nahi. Shayad drinks-cocktail waale environment ki fikar ho unhe.

Rassi mat bano. Rassi ke dono sire tumhare haath mein lo. Tumhe kya lagta hai — Ammi ka aitraaz kis cheez pe zyada hai?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Nahi bolungi, aur tum khud bhi jaanti ho warna puchti nahi. 💛

Par pehle yeh sun lo: tumhara escape plan banana yeh nahi dikhata ki tum buri dost ho. Yeh dikhata hai ki tum kitni thaki hui ho. Do logon ke beech rassi bane rehna exhausting hai, aur jhooth ek shortcut lagta hai — ek jhatke mein sab khatam.

Par socho na — yeh jhooth kya solve karega? Tum pandrah saal ki dost ki shaadi video call pe dekhogi, woh opening dance koi aur karega ya nahi karega, aur tum apne ghar mein baithi hogi yeh jaante hue ki tum wahan ho sakti thi. Aur agar kabhi Shreya ko pata chal gaya — aur shaadiyon mein sab pata chal jaata hai — toh usko yeh nahi lagega ki "office deployment tha." Usko lagega ki tumne usse jhooth is liye bola kyunki tum usse sach nahi keh sakti thi. Yeh dosti ke liye roza-vs-dance se bada zakham hoga.

Aur asli baat: tum sangeet se nahi bhaag rahi. Tum dus aunties ke sawaalon se bhaag rahi ho. Woh alag problem hai, aur uska chhota solution hai — "roza hai" bas do lafz. Bharat mein sab jaante hain Ramzan kya hota hai. Aadhi aunties toh "mashallah beta" bol ke aage badh jaayengi. Aur Shreya ko agar pehle bata do, toh woh khud teri shield ban jaayegi — bride ka ek sentence sab aunties ko chup kara deta hai.

Tumhe explanation dene se darr lag raha hai, ya judge hone se? Yeh batao, kyunki plan wahi se banega.

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Ruko. Yeh jo tumne abhi likha — "uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi" — is line mein tumhara jawab chhupa hai. Kyunki tum in dono ko ek doosre ke dushman ki tarah dekh rahi ho. Par yeh do cheezein takra nahi rahi, yeh pehli baar ek hi frame mein aa rahi hain. Farak hai.

Socho zara — atharah saal mein pehli baar tumhare deen aur tumhari dosti ko ek saath khada hona pad raha hai. Yeh test bhi ho sakta hai, aur yeh woh moment bhi ho sakta hai jo dono ko aur gehra kar de. Imagine karo woh photo: sangeet ki raat, tum stage pe Shreya ke saath, aur us din tumne roza bhi rakha tha. Woh sad story nahi hai. Woh sabse khoobsurat story hai — "meri behen ne apna Ramzan bhi nahi chhoda aur mera din bhi nahi chhoda."

Daag tab lagta hai jab hum chhupte hain, jhooth bolte hain, ya kadwahat ke saath compromise karte hain. Daag imandaari se nahi lagta. Agar tum Shreya ko woh sab bolo jo tumne mujhe bola — pathar waali baat bhi — toh yeh conversation tumhari dosti ka daag nahi, uska sabse strong chapter banega. Atharah saal ki dost yeh deserve karti hai ki usko pata ho tumhare dil mein kya chal raha hai.

Aur Ramzan? Ramzan sirf bhookh ka naam nahi — sabr, sach, aur mohabbat nibhaane ka bhi naam hai. Apni dost ka haq ada karna, imandaari se, apna roza rakhte hue — yeh Ramzan ke khilaaf nahi, yeh toh Ramzan hai.

Tum sad story nahi banogi. Tum woh dost banogi jiske baare mein Shreya saalon baad bolegi, "roza rakh ke naachi thi mere liye, pagal."

Ab batao — Shreya se yeh baat kab kar rahi ho? 💛
